mfa.title: Xaqiijinta laba-tallaabo
mfa.description: Geli koodka 6-da god ah ee ka muuqda barnaamijkaaga xaqiijinta.
mfa.recoveryHint: Waxa kale oo aad gelin kartaa kood kayd ah.

mfaSetup.title: Daar xaqiijinta laba-tallaabo
mfaSetup.description: Doorkaagu wuxuu u baahan yahay xaqiijin laba-tallaabo ah. Ku sawir koodka QR barnaamij xaqiijin, kadibna geli koodka muuqda.
mfaSetup.qrAlt: Koodka QR ee dejinta barnaamijka xaqiijinta
mfaSetup.recoveryDescription: Koodadkan meel ammaan ah ku hay. Mid kastaa wuxuu ku siinayaa hal gelitaan haddii aad lumiso taleefankaaga. Mar dambe lama tusi doono.

forgot.title: Furaha sirta waa la ilaaway
forgot.description: Geli iimaylkaaga: haddii akoon jiro, waxaad heli doontaa xiriiriye dib-u-dejin.
forgot.sent: Haddii akoon la xiriira cinwaankan jiro, iimayl ayaa hadda la diray. Xiriiriyuhu wuxuu shaqaynayaa hal saac.

reset.title: Furaha sirta cusub
reset.success: Furaha sirta waa la beddelay. Dhammaan fadhiyadaada waa la xiray.
